own_solution.law: Energy conservation gives Pt = mcΔT, so t = 2 × 4186 × 40 / 1500 = 223.2533333333 s. Adding q kilograms at the same initial temperature before heating gives t = (2 + q) × 4186 × 40 / 1500.
assumptions: The heater delivers constant power to the heated water.
The stated specific heat capacity is constant over the temperature range.
No heat is lost and no phase change occurs.
Water added before heating joins the heated mass at the same initial temperature.
